_notes: All numbers come from the project's own runs on the provided dataset (records of unverified provenance).
Predictions are clipped at zero. Test period = target dates 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-29 (6,300 rows per horizon).
Validation = target dates in 2023 (3,120 rows). Alert cutoff 8 and Critical cutoff 14 were chosen on validation only.
Not a clinically validated or officially approved public-health system.

alert_quality_test_cutoff_8.definition: Alert = predicted cases >= 8. Positive = actual cases >= 10 (High or Critical).

validation_residual_quantiles_actual_min.definition: Quantiles of (actual - predicted) on 2023 validation data. Used for an approximate range only, not a formal confidence interval.

baseline_comparison_2w_test.note: XGBoost row is the 2-week XGBoost model from the validation phase, not the deployed HistGradientBoosting model.

rolling_origin_2w_xgboost.note: Train on all years before the test year; target-date split. 2023 was used to choose the alert cutoff, so it is not independent.

feature_removal_2w_xgboost_validation_ma.note: Higher MAE = worse. Shows which input groups the model depends on; not causal evidence.

limitations: Dataset provenance and licence are unverified; rows are called dataset records, not confirmed surveillance data.
The test period (2024-2025) is two quiet years with only 15 actual Critical weeks, so Critical results are statistically fragile.
More than half of High alerts are false alarms (precision about 40-46% at cutoff 8).
Ward vulnerability values never change over time, so the model cannot learn how changing them would affect dengue.
No month or week-of-year feature; rainfall may partly stand in for season. Feature effects are not causal.
No live weather source: predictions use weather records from the dataset.
